config.description: Research uses only RGB, interpolating the adjustable dim and bright endpoint colours with brightness. Default dim RGB (255,126,0), bright RGB (255,139,22), inspired by roughly 1800–2000 K candlelight; not a calibrated Kelvin setting. Selfmade stays the fixed-temperature backup. Test range repeats bright 5 s, one smooth RGB/brightness fade 10 s, dim 5 s, off 5 s until Stop. No flicker/noise in Test range. RGB endpoints refresh each cycle; normal Research reads them live. Existing ownership, planned-off handling and restoration apply.

variables.problem:
{% if is_state('script.candle_test_restore','on') or is_state('script.candle_test_stop','on') or states('input_text.candle_test_session')|from_json(default={}) %}Previous test is still returning control. Try again in a moment.
{% elif not is_state('automation.candle_test_lifecycle','on') %}Test recovery is unavailable.
{% elif not is_state('binary_sensor.zigbee2mqtt_bridge_connection_state','on') %}Zigbee bridge is offline.
{% elif ['script.mys_candle_selfmade','script.mys_candle_trial_20261023','script.mys_candle_report_trial','script.bedroom_candle_report_trial','script.candle_report_rooms_60s'] | select('is_state','on') | list | count > 0 %}Stop the other candle experiment first.
{% elif range_test and preset != 'Research' %}Select Research for the range sweep.
{% elif preset == 'Research' and ((state_attr(lamp,'supported_color_modes') or []) | select('in',['xy','hs','rgb','rgbw','rgbww']) | list | count == 0) %}Research needs a colour-capable lamp. Choose another lamp or Selfmade.
{% elif not is_state(lamp,'on') %}Turn the selected lamp on before starting.
{% elif not is_state_attr(lamp,'color_mode','color_temp') %}Set the selected lamp to white light before starting.
{% elif preset == 'Selfmade' and period_min|float > period_max|float %}Minimum cycle must be at most maximum cycle.
{% else %}{% endif %}

variables.cycle_phase: {{ 5 * cycle_position|float / fall_share|float if cycle_position|float <= fall_share|float else 5 + 5 * (cycle_position|float - fall_share|float) / (1 - fall_share|float) }}
variables.cycle_low: {{ (range(5, 8) | random) if new_cycle or frames|int == 0 else cycle_low }}
variables.wave_value: {% set i = cycle_phase|int % 10 %}{% set f = cycle_phase|float - cycle_phase|int %}{{ wave[i]|float + f * (wave[(i + 1) % 10]|float - wave[i]|float) }}

variables.color_due: {{ preset == 'Research' and (as_timestamp(now()) >= color_next_ts|float or (range_test and range_phase|float <= 0)) }}
variables.color_phase: {{ range_phase|float if range_test else ([0,[1,(level|float-effect_low|float)/(effect_high|float-effect_low|float)]|min]|max if effect_high|float > effect_low|float else 0.5) }}
variables.color_rgb: {% set A = state_attr('light.candle_test_rgb_crossover','rgb_color') or [255,139,22] %}{% set B = state_attr('light.candle_test_rgb_warm_end','rgb_color') or [255,126,0] %}{{ [(A[0]+(B[0]-A[0])*rgb_mix|float)|round|int,(A[1]+(B[1]-A[1])*rgb_mix|float)|round|int,(A[2]+(B[2]-A[2])*rgb_mix|float)|round|int] }}

variables.color_next_ts: {{ as_timestamp(now()) + (0.5 if range_test else 1) if color_due else color_next_ts|float }}
variables.range_done: {{ range_test and range_phase|float <= 0 and previous|int == effect_low|int and color_last_key == color_key }}
